name: Puddles Carny
text:
The Puddles are an awful place to live, and that makes what you do so important. You've long adored the carnival life, either as a roustabout, a performer, or as something in between, but you've found that it's feats of brawn or balance that tend to put the biggest smiles on downtrodden faces. You don't want to be a Puddles carny all your life, and you've long admired the great works of art on display throughout the city. Maybe one day your own artwork will be as highly regarded, but until then, well—the show must go on.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Strength or Dexterity, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Athletics skill and in the Art Lore skill. You gain the Hefty Hauler skill feat.
